original_companion_detail.name: Read-only repositories
original_companion_detail.question: Should Puppet Master support browsing a repository whose native storage cannot be written?

original_companion_detail.name: Browse an earlier repository state
original_companion_detail.question: Should users be able to browse the repository as it looked at a selected earlier operation?
original_companion_detail.why_it_came_up: The research names viewing the repository at past operations as a distinct UI capability. Frozen operation show/log and exact recovery do not clearly promise a graph-and-content browsing mode pinned to that old view. Such browsing must preserve historical visibility and never imply restoration. Existing exact operation inspection and isolated restore are already explicit; the optional addition is a coordinated full historical graph/tree/bookmark browsing context, not another operation-show action.
original_companion_detail.what_you_get: Inspection of historical graph and content without restoring it.
original_companion_detail.costs: Historical query isolation, retention gaps and clear indication of the viewed state.
options: Add a clearly labeled earlier-state browsing mode
Keep the existing operation details and recovery controls
